baseline.policy: Use the current cash-feasible core ranking over the frozen 57-name tradeable pool without a disclosure-plus-flow condition.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: At most one existing core replacement slot and no production allocation
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Repository cash-equity commissions and slippage at identical notional; no financing credit
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: PLTR common stock only; no option, leverage, inverse product, or proxy mapping
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Existing canonical equity liquidity and gap-cancel rules must pass at the next regular-session open
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Issuer disclosure, session-close price signal and daily flow must all be known before next-open entry

falsifier: Reject or park if any surface is not PIT for the decision clock, if there are fewer than five independent executable touches in every canonical window, if the treatment adds no value over event-only and price-only constituents, if no valid novelty axis survives prior fingerprints, if PLTR exceeds 40% of positive contribution, or if it fails cash, SPY, QQQ and displaced-core replacement comparators after costs.
hypothesis: For Palantir, a source-dated positive quarterly disclosure that already has a price-revealed core signal may retain post-disclosure underreaction only when same-session Moomoo daily capital flow is positive; evaluated outcome-blind at next-open H10 and H20, the treatment must add replacement value over cash, SPY, QQQ and the displaced baseline core candidate.
replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash, identical-interval SPY and QQQ, and the exact baseline core candidate displaced at the same slot, timing, costs and notional.
title: PLTR official-disclosure and capital-flow convergence lead

treatment.policy: After the official quarterly disclosure and current session close are known, require the existing PLTR price-revealed core signal and positive same-session Moomoo daily capital flow; enter only at the next regular-session open, evaluate fixed H10 and H20 horizons, and never alter production or place an order.

why_not_arbitraged: The issuer disclosure is public and the price moved sharply, so most information may already be consumed. Any residual edge must come from genuinely PIT, independently informative flow rather than the widely observed headline or a mechanical post-gap reaction, and must survive opportunity-cost and concentration constraints.
